name: GUIGuard-Bench Anonymous Repository
description: Anonymous repository artifact for GUIGuard-Bench, containing evaluation code, package documentation, and example data for privacy-aware GUI-agent evaluation. The repository includes planner evaluation, privacy recognition, and ScreenSpot-style grounding evaluation packages, plus a dataset_example subset with 60 trajectory tasks (34 Android + 26 PC), 897 original trajectory screenshots, region-level privacy labels, and 290 grounding samples with original, black-mask, and LLM-replacement image variants.

recordSet.name: grounding_manifest
recordSet.description: Materializable record set for dataset_example/grounding_data/manifest.jsonl. Each row describes one grounding sample with the source image name, next-action plan, action string, and target UI element. The example contains 290 rows.

field.description: Original sample id before copying into the example manifest.

recordSet.name: grounding_boxes
recordSet.description: Materializable record set for dataset_example/grounding_data/boxes.jsonl. Each row gives a target action and ground-truth bounding box for ScreenSpot-style point-in-box grounding evaluation. The example contains 290 rows.

field.name: bbox_xyxy
field.description: Ground-truth bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] in image pixel coordinates. Kept as text/list by JSONL readers for compatibility.

field.name: target_visible
field.description: Whether the target element is visible.

rai:dataCollection: The anonymous repository artifact packages evaluation code and a dataset_example subset for smoke tests and demonstrations. The example subset contains 60 GUI trajectory tasks (34 Android and 26 PC), 897 original trajectory screenshots, region-level privacy annotations, and 290 grounding examples with original, black-mask, and LLM-replacement image variants. The official full benchmark split is hosted separately on Hugging Face.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: The repository contains code, documentation, and example data derived from the GUIGuard-Bench benchmark. Full raw benchmark data is not stored in this anonymous repository; users should use the official complete benchmark release for full-scale evaluation.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Example trajectory screenshots and annotation files are packaged in dataset_example for smoke testing the evaluation code.
Grounding examples are prepared as manifest.jsonl, boxes.jsonl, samples.json, and three image variants: original, black, and replace_llm.
Evaluation packages use OpenAI-compatible APIs and deterministic local parsing/normalization utilities.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Privacy annotations in dataset_example/image_privacy_labels_example.json are region-level labels derived from the GUIGuard-Bench annotation workflow.
Grounding boxes in dataset_example/grounding_data/boxes.jsonl specify target-visible click regions in [x1, y1, x2, y2] pixel coordinates.
The full annotation protocol, quality review, and official benchmark split are documented in the benchmark metadata.
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The anonymous example data is for smoke tests and reproducibility checks; official benchmark metrics should be computed on the Hugging Face dataset split.
rai:annotationsPerItem: The anonymous grounding example has one click target box per grounding sample. The privacy-label example file contains region-level privacy annotations per screenshot.
rai:annotatorDemographics: See the official benchmark metadata for full annotation-team documentation.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Evaluation code supports OpenAI-compatible multimodal models, LLM-as-judge scoring, and ScreenSpot-style point parsing.
rai:dataBiases: The anonymous dataset_example subset is a small demonstration subset and should not be treated as representative of the full benchmark distribution.
The example data focuses on Android and PC GUI screenshots and inherits platform, language, and application biases from the underlying benchmark.
rai:dataUseCases: Installing and testing GUIGuard-Bench evaluation packages.
Smoke-testing protected-screen planning, privacy recognition, and click grounding pipelines.
Reproducing example data loading and output formats before running the full benchmark.
rai:dataLimitations: The anonymous repository is not the complete official benchmark dataset.
dataset_example is intended for code-path validation and small demonstrations, not final benchmark reporting.
Full benchmark evaluation requires access to the complete benchmark data release.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The repository supports research on privacy-aware GUI agents by providing reproducible evaluation code and examples for privacy recognition, protected-screen planning, and GUI grounding under privacy transformations.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Example screenshots may contain synthetic or controlled personal-looking UI content used for privacy-risk evaluation.
Users should treat screenshots and labels as privacy-sensitive research data and follow the repository and dataset license terms.
rai:hasSyntheticData: Partially. The anonymous repository includes example GUI screenshots and annotations derived from the GUIGuard-Bench benchmark, plus protected image variants such as black masks and LLM-replacement images.
